# SoundPool

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Audio` · class

```csharp
public sealed class SoundPool : IDisposable
```

A pool that plays a single [`SoundSegment`](SoundSegment.md) cue with a fixed cap on the number of concurrent active instances.

## Remarks

Instances overlap, up to [`VoiceLimit`](#voicelimit) ([`DefaultVoiceLimit`](#defaultvoicelimit) unless the pool is made with another): a play takes a voice that has finished, or creates one while the pool has fewer than its limit, so a cue that never overlaps keeps one voice. The cost of engaging the platform is paid once per voice, when it's created; replays allocate nothing.

When every voice is playing at the instance limit, the oldest is stolen to make room for the new play.

An instance can play at less than full volume, and the playing instances can fade out before they stop: a voice gets its own [`VolumeControl`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/VolumeControl.md) the first time either is needed.

The pool's [`VolumeControl`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/VolumeControl.md) puts every instance under a shared control, so a game's settings can turn all its sound effects up or down.

## Fields

### DefaultVoiceLimit

```csharp
public const int DefaultVoiceLimit = 8;
```

The instances a cue plays at once unless the pool is made with another limit: rapid replays (collecting items, taps) overlap instead of cutting each other off.

## Methods

### Dispose

```csharp
public void Dispose()
```

Stops and releases the pool's voices and their controls. Its [`VolumeControl`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/VolumeControl.md) isn't the pool's own, so it stays.

### FadeOutAll

```csharp
public void FadeOutAll(TimeSpan duration, TimeService time)
```

Types: [`TimeService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/TimeService.md)

Fades every playing instance out over `duration` and then stops it. An instance played again before then isn't part of the fade any more.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `duration` | How long the fade takes. |
| `time` | The game's clock, which says when the fade has ended: stopping game time holds the instances, silent, until it runs again. |

### Play

```csharp
public void Play(float volume = 1f)
```

Starts a new instance of the cue at a volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full), clamped to that: on a voice that has finished, on a new voice while the pool is under its limit, or else on the oldest playing voice.

**Throws `ObjectDisposedException`:** The pool or its sound has been disposed.

**Throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`:** The volume is not a number.

### Prepare

```csharp
public void Prepare(int voices)
```

Creates voices now, up to `voices` or the limit, instead of on the first overlap of the cue, which is usually the busiest moment of the game. Call it while loading.

### StopAll

```csharp
public void StopAll()
```

Stops every voice in the pool.
